title: About X-Ample Development
subtitle: We build premium FiveM assets, Discord bots, websites, and custom solutions—with clean UX, performance-first code, and support you can rely on.
body:
X-Ample Development (also known as X-Ample Studios) creates modern FiveM scripts, MLOs, Discord bots, websites, and gameplay experiences. We focus on readable UI, practical features, and maintainable code. We also handle bug hunting, performance fixes, and optimization so your projects run smoothly.

Whether you're upgrading an existing community, launching a new product, or need something fixed or polished, we ship quality work and can take on custom development when you need something bespoke.

highlights.title: Quality first
highlights.body: Consistent UI, sensible defaults, and attention to detail.

highlights.title: Performance-minded
highlights.body: Built to run smoothly and scale with your player base or traffic.

highlights.title: Support & iteration
highlights.body: We listen, fix issues quickly, and keep improving.

highlights.title: Security first
highlights.body: Security is our top priority; we keep scripts and apps secure and up to date.

highlights.title: Privacy focused
highlights.body: We ensure our work is privacy-focused and does not collect personal data without need.
